info.title: openconfig-ap-manager
info.description:
This module defines the top level configuration and state data for a system which manages Access Points.

**Module:** `openconfig-ap-manager`
**Root nodes:** provision-aps, joined-aps
**Paths:** 9 | **Operations:** 21

GET/PUT/PATCH/DELETE for config nodes, GET-only for state (config false) nodes.

get.description: Top most container for assigning hostnames to APs.

mac.description: Reference to the MAC address list key. This leaf is a reference only and not to be configured.

MAC address of the AP primary Ethernet interface. If AP has multiple Ethernet interfaces, this would be the MAC printed on the unit label and referenced within the management system. Vendors MUST reject attempts to configure this leaf.
